references.text: Deborah had previously commanded Barak to gather ten thousand men from Zebulun and Naphtali, and here we see him carrying out this command.
The song of Deborah describes how the tribes of Zebulun and Naphtali followed Barak down into the valley to fight against Sisera.
Zebulun and Naphtali are praised for risking their lives on the heights of the battlefield, referring to the events in this verse.
Barak is mentioned among the heroes of faith who by faith conquered kingdoms and carried out justice.
Ten thousand men was the usual number gathered for battle, as also mentioned in the census on the plains of Moab.
Gideon also called Zebulun and Naphtali to battle, in a similar way as Barak did here.
